name: Welcome Email - Premium Customer Onboarding 2026
description: Updated premium welcome email template for new customers with enhanced personalization and 2026 feature highlights. Includes links to new training materials and premium support options.
subject: Welcome to Premium - Your Journey Starts Here!
body_html:
Dear Valued Customer,

Welcome to our Premium Platform! We're thrilled to have you as a premium member.

Your premium account is now active with exclusive benefits:

- Priority Support: 24/7 dedicated support team
- Advanced Features: Full access to all premium tools
- Training Sessions: One-on-one onboarding with our experts
- Community Access: Join our exclusive premium member community

Your premium benefits include:
• Unlimited storage and bandwidth
• Advanced analytics and reporting
• API access for integrations
• Monthly strategy consultations

Get started with your premium dashboard or schedule your complimentary onboarding session.

We're here to ensure your success!

Best regards,
The Premium Team
